name: Arizona Plastics Machinery
old_description: is the largest U.S.-based manufacturer of industry-leading drying, conveying, and complete materials-handling systems for the plastics industry.
about:
Arizona Plastics Machinery (APM) operates from Oracle, Arizona, where it was founded in 1983 by Craig, a plastics technology and business graduate who has supplied equipment to the plastics industry since that year. The company began as a manufacturers' representative focused on plastics processing equipment.

APM represents a portfolio of equipment suppliers covering the full spectrum of plastics processing. Its line card includes Haitian injection molding machines ranging from 44 to 7,456 tons; Novatec drying, blending, and resin-handling systems; Thermal Care process cooling equipment such as chillers, temperature controllers, and cooling towers; Rapid Granulator size-reduction machinery for recycling and in-line applications; Harvard Factory Automation conveyor systems; Kosmek hydraulic, pneumatic, and magnetic clamping systems; Santa Fe Machine plasticizing components including screws, barrels, and tip assemblies; Ensign bulk material handling equipment; and TEKLEEN self-cleaning water filters. Beyond product representation, APM provides technical consulting, equipment selection assistance, production-line optimization, and troubleshooting support.

The firm serves plastics processors across injection molding, extrusion, recycling, and general plastics manufacturing. Customers range from molders seeking auxiliary equipment to plants needing complete material-handling, cooling, or automation solutions.

APM differentiates itself through the breadth of its equipment offerings, the hands-on expertise of its founder, and long-standing partnerships with manufacturers that emphasize durability and performance.
